mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair tacrolimus clearance, leading to increased tacrolimus levels and toxicity; both agents are also independently nephrotoxic.
action: Monitor renal function, tacrolimus trough levels, and electrolytes closely; consider amphotericin B lipid formulations (less nephrotoxic); adjust tacrolimus dosing based on levels; ensure aggressive electrolyte replacement.
